title: Offline send-composition performance verification
scope: Verify exact offline authority, production-mechanism execution, evidence retention and classification, configured/effective cell semantics, blocked statistical analysis, held-out selector assessment, and clean repository closeout without production activation, CI, push, or unrelated-axis work.
verification_method: Schema and canonical hash validation; exact Git, binary, proof, review, host, manifest, cell, workload, and artifact identity; runtime mechanism counters from production loopback connections; activation and ownership gates; serial counterbalanced blocks; deterministic effect and bootstrap calculations; frozen train/holdout separation; adversarial authorization and substitution tests; retained correctness regressions; focused Release builds; direct SpecTrace validation; diff, archive, bundle, and clean-worktree checks.
preconditions: Local main contains 337c171f747eee29643aa49fd9f1628aa770813f and its accepted ancestry.
Both reviewed single-axis proofs and the passed correctness interaction remain valid.
The worktree is clean and the measured binary is built from the exact committed source.
Only the exact send_composition four-cell family is authorized for offline measurement.
procedure: Validate the campaign contract, reviewed proofs, correctness review, clean source, binary, and host.
Prove ordinary and mismatched multi-axis configuration is denied while exact campaign cells configure.
Run a short serial pilot in counterbalanced order and assess variance, drift, correctness, and activation.
Run accepted training contexts and retain every run with classification and checksums.
Analyze batch, buffer, configured interaction, context effects, confidence intervals, and guardrails.
Assess legitimate runtime observations using training data only and freeze a rule or no-rule conclusion.
Run held-out contexts and report accuracy, regret, guardrails, and stability without retuning.
Independently validate evidence, conclusions, shadow neutrality when applicable, and repository cleanup.
Run prior regressions, focused builds/tests, direct SpecTrace validation, git diff --check, archive, bundle, and final clean-state checks.
expected_result: The exact four configured cells execute through production mechanisms; every run is retained and classified; only activation-eligible evidence supports conclusions; configured and effective equivalence is explicit; analysis and holdout results reproduce; any selector is shadow-only and evidence-backed or a no-rule conclusion is retained; and local main is clean with no push, CI change, active_internal, or production activation.
status_summary: Passed for the bounded offline milestone and activation-qualified extension: the original 160-run campaign and the extension's 176-run production-seam campaign validated; all runs were retained and classified; three new holdouts supplied complete eligible or expected-equivalent four-cell blocks; materializations, projection, and analysis rebuilt byte-identically; and uncertain train and holdout effects plus 2-of-3 held-out rule accuracy produced measurement_completed_no_stable_rule. No selector was emitted. Production activation, active_internal, and CI changes remained absent.
